entities.name: Varena
entities.description: One of the best fighters in the House of Fentesk in Kush on Dominaria, a ninth-rank fighter who later became the Grand Master of the Arena.

entities.name: House of Fentesk
entities.description: A fighting house in Kush on Dominaria to which Varena belonged.

entities.name: Kush
entities.description: A place on Dominaria where the House of Fentesk is based.

entities.name: Dominaria

entities.name: Time of Troubles

entities.name: Arena
entities.description: The fighting arena of which Varena became Grand Master.

entities.name: Garth
entities.description: A fighter whose power Varena was tasked to test; he became her lover and friend and was forced to kill her in the festival's last match.

entities.name: Norreen
entities.description: A woman with whom Varena had a strange friendship and rivalry.

entities.name: Zarel
entities.description: A figure who held Garth in his prison.

entities.name: Hammen
entities.description: The one who revived Varena after her death.
